head: codex/5864-distributed-certificate-lifecycle
title: [v0.92][WP-04.02] Distributed certificate purposes and lifecycle
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5864

## Summary

- add five purpose-separated distributed certificate authorities
- enforce monotonic bounded rotation and one identity per quorum vote
- enforce expiry, immediate revocation, and atomic identity-wide compromise fencing
- validate durable state and resource ceilings fail closed

## Validation

- `cargo nextest run --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --test distributed_certificates --no-tests=fail` — 10 passed
- `cargo clippy --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --test distributed_certificates -- -D warnings` — passed
- exact proof-receipt validator — passed
- independent exact-head review — passed with no findings

## Boundary

This child owns only `adl-runtime/src/distributed/certificates.rs` and `adl-runtime/tests/distributed_certificates.rs`. QUIC/TLS integration remains with dependent child #5865.
